headline: Gold drops to 14-month low as Fed rate hike expectations boost US dollar
summary: Gold prices fell to a 14-month low, down over 30% from their record high earlier this year. Expectations of further US Federal Reserve interest rate hikes pushed Treasury yields and the US dollar higher.
why: Gold is a traditional inflation hedge and store of value that tends to lose appeal when real interest rates and dollar yields rise.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Higher interest rate expectations strengthened bond yields and the dollar, reducing non-yielding gold demand.
